import pytest
from rich.cells import split_text, _split_text
from rich.segment import Segment
from rich.style import Style


def test_split_text_at_column_zero_single_cell():
    """Test splitting single-cell text at column zero returns empty left and full right."""
    text = "hello"
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "hello"


def test_split_text_at_column_zero_double_cell():
    """Test splitting double-cell text at column zero returns empty left and full right."""
    # Chinese characters are typically double-width
    text = "你好"
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "你好"


def test_split_text_at_column_zero_mixed():
    """Test splitting mixed single and double cell text at column zero."""
    text = "a你b"
    left, right = split_text(text, 0)
    assert left == ""
    assert right == "a你b"


def test_split_text_in_middle():
    """Test that splitting in middle still works correctly."""
    text = "hello"
    left, right = split_text(text, 2)
    assert left == "he"
    assert right == "llo"


def test_split_text_at_end():
    """Test that splitting at or past end still works."""
    text = "hello"
    left, right = split_text(text, 5)
    assert left == "hello"
    assert right == ""


def test_split_text_past_end():
    """Test that splitting past end still works."""
    text = "hello"
    left, right = split_text(text, 10)
    assert left == "hello"
    assert right == ""


def test_split_text_inside_double_cell():
    """Test that splitting inside double-cell character replaces with spaces."""
    text = "a你b"
    # The character 你 occupies cells 1-2, so cutting at cell 1.5 should hit it
    left, right = split_text(text, 2)
    # Position 2 should land in the middle of 你 (which is at position 1-2 in cells)
    # This should replace it with spaces
    assert left == "a "
    assert right == " b"

import pytest
from rich.segment import Segment
from rich.style import Style


def test_segment_split_cells_at_zero():
    """Test that Segment.split_cells at column zero works correctly."""
    segment = Segment("hello", Style())
    left, right = segment.split_cells(0)
    assert left.text == ""
    assert right.text == "hello"
    assert left.style == Style()
    assert right.style == Style()


def test_segment_split_cells_at_zero_with_style():
    """Test that Segment.split_cells at zero preserves style."""
    style = Style(bold=True)
    segment = Segment("world", style)
    left, right = segment.split_cells(0)
    assert left.text == ""
    assert right.text == "world"
    assert left.style == style
    assert right.style == style


def test_segment_split_cells_at_zero_double_width():
    """Test splitting double-width character segment at zero."""
    segment = Segment("你好", Style())
    left, right = segment.split_cells(0)
    assert left.text == ""
    assert right.text == "你好"


def test_segment_split_cells_in_middle():
    """Test that splitting in the middle still works."""
    segment = Segment("hello", Style())
    left, right = segment.split_cells(2)
    assert left.text == "he"
    assert right.text == "llo"


def test_segment_split_cells_at_end():
    """Test splitting at the end."""
    segment = Segment("hello", Style())
    left, right = segment.split_cells(5)
    assert left.text == "hello"
    assert right.text == ""


def test_segment_split_cells_inside_double_width():
    """Test splitting inside a double-width character."""
    segment = Segment("a你", Style())
    left, right = segment.split_cells(2)
    assert left.text == "a "
    assert right.text == " 你"

import pytest
from rich.cells import split_graphemes


def test_split_graphemes_basic():
    """Test that split_graphemes works on basic text."""
    text = "hello"
    spans, total_width = split_graphemes(text)
    assert len(spans) == 5
    assert total_width == 5
    assert all(cell_len == 1 for _, _, cell_len in spans)


def test_split_graphemes_double_width():
    """Test split_graphemes with double-width characters."""
    text = "你好"
    spans, total_width = split_graphemes(text)
    assert len(spans) == 2
    assert total_width == 4
    assert all(cell_len == 2 for _, _, cell_len in spans)


def test_split_graphemes_mixed():
    """Test split_graphemes with mixed width characters."""
    text = "a你b"
    spans, total_width = split_graphemes(text)
    assert len(spans) == 3
    assert total_width == 4
    # Single, double, single
    assert spans[0][2] == 1
    assert spans[1][2] == 2
    assert spans[2][2] == 1


def test_split_graphemes_empty():
    """Test split_graphemes on empty string."""
    text = ""
    spans, total_width = split_graphemes(text)
    assert len(spans) == 0
    assert total_width == 0

    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        segment.split_cells(-5)
